title: QuickSign
description: Quick sign text copy & paste for Minecraft. Use Shift+Middle Click to copy sign text and automatically paste it to any other sign type - works in both Survival and Creative mode.
body:
⚡ QuickSign

Lightning-fast sign text duplication for Minecraft


✨ Features
ActionDescription🖱️ Shift + Middle Click on any signCopies all 4 text lines instantly✍️ Auto-Paste when opening the editorText automatically fills in & confirms🌳 Universal CompatibilityWorks with all sign types🗑️ Middle Click in the airClear clipboard instantly🎨 Creative ModePreserves vanilla pick block (copies sign + NBT data)⚔️ Survival / AdventureText-only copying without vanilla restrictions
Supported Sign Types
Oak · Birch · Spruce · Jungle · Acacia · Dark Oak · Mangrove · Cherry · Bamboo · Crimson · Warped

🎯 Perfect For

🏪 Building shops with repeated pricing or info
📝 Duplicating signage across different wood types
🏗️ Server builds requiring consistent messaging
⚡ Quick content transfer without NBT complexity


📦 Installation

Download the latest release
Place the JAR file into your mods folder
Launch Minecraft with Fabric


🔧 Requirements
ComponentVersionMinecraft1.21.1Fabric Loader≥ 0.18.4Fabric APILatest

📖 Usage

⚠️ Note: While text is in the clipboard, signs cannot be edited.

📋 Copy Sign Text
Shift + Middle Click on any sign
→ Text copied (chat confirmation appears)
📌 Paste Text
Right-click a sign to open the editor
→ Previously copied text auto-fills and saves
🗑️ Clear Clipboard
Middle Click while looking at air / empty space
→ Clipboard cleared

🚀 Why QuickSign?

🖥️ Client-Side Only – No server mod required
🪶 Lightweight – Minimal performance impact
🕹️ Intuitive – Natural Minecraft-style controls
🔧 Zero Configuration – Works out of the box
